events.title: Freddie Mercury Tribute
events.blurb: On this day, we remember Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991 at the age of 45; he would have been 80.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, whose legacy continues to inspire generations. A true legend of rock.

events.title: The Beatles' "Rubber Soul" Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album "Rubber Soul" on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turns 61
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. Still sounds as fresh as ever, doesn't it?

events.title: John Lennon Tribute
events.blurb: We remember John Lennon, who tragically passed away on this day in 1980; he would have been 86.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Today, we pause to remember John Lennon, a voice that shaped a generation and continues to resonate. His music lives on.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today would have been the 80th birthday of the legendary David Bowie.

angles.name: Celebrating Bowie
angles.copy: The Starman would have been 80 today. A true innovator and icon, David Bowie's influence is still felt across music and culture.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday, King
angles.copy: He would have been 92 today. The one and only Elvis Presley. Still shaking up the airwaves.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist, Jimmy Page.

angles.name: Guitar God Turns 83
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young today, the guitar wizard himself, Jimmy Page. Still making us want to crank it up to eleven.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Celebrating the 82nd birthday of rock and pop icon, Rod Stewart.

angles.name: Happy Birthday, Rod
angles.copy: Eighty-two today and still got that unmistakable voice. Happy Birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart!

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the iconic frontman of Madness.

angles.name: One Step Beyond 65
angles.copy: He's 66 today! Wishing a very happy birthday to the legend that is Suggs from Madness. What's your favourite Madness track?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the "Wherever I Lay My Hat" singer, Paul Young.

angles.name: Paul Young at 71
angles.copy: Still got that incredible voice! Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young. What's your go-to track from him?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Jolene Turns 81
angles.copy: She's 81 and still working 9 to 5! Happy birthday to the iconic Dolly Parton. What a legend.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Happy 56th birthday to Take That frontman and songwriter, Gary Barlow.

angles.name: Barlow at 56
angles.copy: He's still got it! Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to the one and only Gary Barlow.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Celebrating the 77th birthday of soul and R&B singer, Billy Ocean.

angles.name: Get Outta My Dreams, Get Into My Car!
angles.copy: He's 77 today! Happy Birthday to Billy Ocean, still bringing the good times with his incredible hits.

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Inaugural Ceremony Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its very first induction ceremony, honouring legends like Elvis Presley and The Beatles.

angles.name: Hall of Fame Kicks Off
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago today, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame opened its doors to its first inductees. Who was the first artist you'd have put in?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Happy 55th birthday to Take That member, Mark Owen.

angles.name: Mark Owen at 55
angles.copy: Another Take That legend celebrating a birthday this month! Happy 55th to Mark Owen.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles played their legendary final live performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Rockers
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary musician, singer, and songwriter, Phil Collins.

angles.name: Feel Good Collins at 76
angles.copy: He's 76 today! Wishing a very happy birthday to the incredible Phil Collins. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Happy 67th birthday to the much-loved British actor, Hugh Grant.

angles.name: The Grant Man Turns 67
angles.copy: Still charming everyone! Wishing a very happy 67th birthday to the one and only Hugh Grant.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 46th birthday to pop superstar, Justin Timberlake.

angles.name: JT at 46
angles.copy: He's 46 today! From *NSYNC to solo superstardom, Justin Timberlake still brings the moves and the hits.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly, David Jason
angles.copy: He's 87 today! Wishing a very happy birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason. What's your favourite Del Boy moment?

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1959, Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash, an event famously known as "The Day The Music Died."

angles.name: Remembering Music Legends
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago today, we lost three music pioneers in "The Day The Music Died." Their legacy, however, lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 61st birthday to the "Never Gonna Give You Up" singer, Rick Astley.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up at 61
angles.copy: He's 61 today! Happy Birthday to Rick Astley. We're never gonna give up on his absolute bangers.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Today would have been the 82nd birthday of reggae icon, Bob Marley.

angles.name: One Love for Bob Marley
angles.copy: The reggae legend Bob Marley would have been 82 today. His message of peace and unity resonates now more than ever.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Happy 85th birthday to the legendary singer-songwriter, Carole King.

angles.name: Tapestry at 85
angles.copy: Eighty-five years young today! Wishing a very happy birthday to the incredible Carole King. A true songwriting genius.

events.title: Whitney Houston Tribute
events.blurb: We remember the incomparable Whitney Houston, who passed away on this day in 2012; she would have been 64.

angles.name: Remembering The Voice
angles.copy: Eleven years since we lost 'The Voice'. Remembering the phenomenal Whitney Houston today. Her music is truly timeless.

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, Take That announced their initial split, breaking millions of hearts across the nation.

angles.name: The Day Take That Broke Our Hearts
angles.copy: Twenty-one years ago today, the world briefly stopped when Take That announced their split. Thankfully, they came back stronger!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell, the lead singer of UB40.

angles.name: Red Red Wine at 68
angles.copy: He's 68 today! Wishing a very happy birthday to the voice of UB40, Ali Campbell. Still making us feel good.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Happy 36th birthday to the global superstar, Ed Sheeran.

angles.name: Happy Birthday, Ed!
angles.copy: He's 36 today! Wishing a very happy birthday to the phenomenal Ed Sheeran. What's your favourite track?

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: Today would have been the 84th birthday of The Beatles' lead guitarist, George Harrison.

angles.name: Remembering The Quiet Beatle
angles.copy: The Quiet Beatle, George Harrison, would have been 84 today. His timeless songs continue to bring light to the world.

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83
events.blurb: Happy 83rd birthday to the iconic frontman of The Who, Roger Daltrey.

angles.name: The Who's Main Man at 83
angles.copy: Eighty-three today! Wishing a very happy birthday to the legendary Roger Daltrey, still smashing it with The Who.

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 69th birthday to the "Wouldn't It Be Good" singer, Nik Kershaw.

angles.name: Wouldn't It Be Good at 69
angles.copy: He's 69 today! Happy birthday to the brilliant Nik Kershaw. Still sounds fantastic, doesn't he?

events.title: Chris Martin turns 50
events.blurb: Happy 50th birthday to Coldplay frontman, Chris Martin.

angles.name: Half Century for Chris Martin
angles.copy: He's 50 today! Wishing a very happy birthday to Coldplay's Chris Martin. Still rocking stadiums around the world.

events.title: Jon Bon Jovi turns 65
events.blurb: Happy 65th birthday to the legendary Bon Jovi frontman, Jon Bon Jovi.

angles.name: Livin' On A Prayer at 65
angles.copy: He's 65 today! Wishing a very happy birthday to the one and only Jon Bon Jovi. Still got that rock star swagger.

events.title: Chris Rea would have been 76
events.blurb: Today would have been the 76th birthday of the distinctive singer-songwriter, Chris Rea.

angles.name: Remembering Chris Rea
angles.copy: Remembering the distinctive voice of Chris Rea, who would have been 76 today. His music always brings that touch of class.

events.title: Mary Wilson would have been 83
events.blurb: Today would have been the 83rd birthday of Mary Wilson, co-founder of The Supremes.

angles.name: Remembering A Supreme
angles.copy: Remembering Mary Wilson, a true icon and co-founder of The Supremes, who would have been 83 today. Her legacy shines bright.

events.title: Michael Jackson's Moonwalk Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1983, Michael Jackson debuted his iconic Moonwalk dance move during his performance of "Billie Jean" at Motown 25.

angles.name: The Moonwalk Debuts
angles.copy: Forty-four years ago today, Michael Jackson changed dance forever with his iconic Moonwalk debut. Still mesmerising!
